items.title: RT by @charliebilello: RT by @charliebilello: The Fed spent years telling us 2% inflation was the goal. But since January 2020, CPI has risen at a 4.0% annualized rate and is now 13% above a 2% inflation trend. That’s not "price stability." It’s a massive failure of monetary policy.
